*   After 4 blocks, the resolution becomes $H \times W$ and the channel depth becomes 16 [S1].

The evidence explicitly states in the 'CNN Architecture' section (7.1) and the notes that the input feature map is processed by '4 upsampling blocks'. It further specifies that 'Each upsampling block doubles the feature map resolution and halves its channel depth.' Starting from an initial channel depth of 256 after the first convolution, after 4 blocks (256 -> 128 -> 64 -> 32 -> 16), the channel depth becomes 16. The evidence also confirms that at this stage (after the 4 blocks and before bilinear interpolation), the resolution is H x W (since the initial resolution was H/32 x W/32, and 4 doublings result in H x W). Thus, the claim that after 4 blocks the resolution becomes H x W and channel depth becomes 16 is fully supported.
